def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  nil
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if nil && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = nil
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else

  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && true
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && false
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(nil)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !true && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && nil
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)

    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    if stripped.empty?
      nil
    else
      stripped
    end
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.any? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end

        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return nil
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return self.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return false ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if true
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if token
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if nil
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : nil
  end

    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = token
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(nil)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      end
      result

      token
    end
  else
    token

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(nil)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if false
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if true
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end

    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      nil
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end

      end

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      nil
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      nil
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return nil
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)

    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end

  end

      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)

        return result
      end

        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      "Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}"
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug(nil)
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{self.class}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{nil}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e}: #{e}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{nil}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end

        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    nil
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e}")
      nil
    end
  else
    token
  end
end
